current_dependency.availability_effect: Loss of Render removes the current static governed gateway path, leaving local classification fallback.

site_existing_mechanism.current_limitation: A verified advertisement replaces endpoint/health values but inherits config.enabled; the static config is therefore still enabled to preserve the Render fallback.

dual_run_sequence.requirement: A canonical StegVerse node advertisement passes node_id, capability_id, health-bound, non-authority, origin-binding and advertisement SHA-256 checks.
With Render still configured, browser discovery selects the verified sovereign node first and a governed request/health check succeeds with exact transition identity and false authority fields.
Block or invalidate the Render endpoint while the sovereign node is available; governed request remains on the sovereign node and canonical state/receipts remain valid.

Change discovery success to return enabled=true from verified advertisement; set static config enabled=false with no Render endpoint/health endpoint. Preserve LOCAL_CLASSIFICATION when no verified sovereign node exists.

With Render unavailable/deleted, verified sovereign node path succeeds; with both Render and sovereign node unavailable, Site fails closed to LOCAL_CLASSIFICATION rather than a provider-required blocker.
Only after steps 1-5: remove Render-specific runtime/config references that are not historical provenance, revoke unused Render credentials/resources, and activate anti-regression coverage.

collision_boundary.rule: Site #497 must not mutate that validator or shared task-runner surfaces while #501 remains active.
collision_boundary.next_machine_action: After #501 releases or transfers ownership, apply the cutover contract to data/ecosystem-chat-gateway.json and assets/ecosystem-chat-node-discovery.js with corresponding validator updates through the owning lane.

acceptance: Render outage/deletion does not change canonical gateway readiness when a verified sovereign node is healthy.
No Render endpoint is required in static Site configuration after cutover.
No Render credential or deployment state is an activation/recovery predicate.
Local classification remains available when no governed sovereign node is verified.
Historical Render evidence may remain but cannot be selected as current fallback.
